items.title: Global websites shut down after AI found a critical flaw affecting 70% of the internet
items.brief: Several government and company websites around the world went dark briefly on Wednesday, after artificial intelligence helped discover and address critical bugs that could affect 70% of the internet.

items.title: Construction on Trump’s 250-foot triumphal arch in DC could begin in just two weeks
items.brief: The Trump administration told a judge Wednesday evening that construction on the president’s controversial 250-foot triumphal arch could begin in just two weeks, days after the midterm elections.

items.title: Subtropical Storm Josephine forms off Mid-Atlantic coast
items.brief: Subtropical Storm Josephine just formed off the coast of the Mid-Atlantic, but will largely be a mere nuisance for coastal areas as it moves north.

items.title: Teacher who survived Oregon school shooting says she had no chance to protect children
items.brief: (AP) – A teacher wounded in last week’s attack on a special education classroom at an Oregon elementary school says she never had a chance to try to shelter any of the children inside.
